content:
We've just implemented a major change to how the #queue works for reviewing pull requests to Mathlib. There will no longer be an awaiting-review label for Mathlib PRs. By default all open PRs will be considered ready for review. To indicate otherwise, you should use one of the following:

  • Mark the PR as a draft PR, or add the WIP label.
  • Add the awaiting-CI label, to indicate you're not sure whether the PR will pass CI yet. This label will automatically be removed the first time your PR goes green.
  • Reviewers may add the awaiting-author label to your PR. This means that the PR is your responsibility again, and in particular it may not receive any further attention until you remember to remove awaiting-author!
  • You or a reviewer may add the blocked-by-other-PR label to indicate that another PR needs to be merged before this one can be.

There are also some automatic blocks that will prevent a PR from being considered for review:

  • CI failing. Please make sure that your PR builds, and the linter succeeds.
  • The merge-conflict label. This is managed automatically by a bot, so carefully merging master into your PR and pushing should result in this label disappearing.

Contributors hopefully know that the #queue linkifier goes to a custom Github search page, and that many of the Mathlib reviewers use this to look for reviewing tasks. It is the responsibility of each PR author to make sure their PR makes it onto this list! If you can't work out why your PR isn't there, please visit the PR reviews channel and make a topic about your PR.
